privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: LinguistPro processes account, course, and learning activity data to deliver language learning services, security controls, and operational support.
privacy.dataUseBody: Data is used for authentication, course enrollment, tutor/student operations, analytics, and incident response. Sensitive secrets and integration tokens are protected using approved security controls.
privacy.dataAccessBody: Access is limited by role-based authorization and operational need. Users may contact support for data-access and correction requests.

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.intro: Refund handling is processed through support review and billing provider constraints. Requests are evaluated against purchase timing, class/session usage, and fraud checks.
refundPolicy.requestWindowBody: Users should submit refund requests as early as possible through the support channel listed on the Support page.
refundPolicy.disputeHandlingBody: Charge disputes are tracked as incidents and resolved with billing evidence, course access logs, and policy review.

support.title: Support and Incident Contact
support.intro: For account, learning, tutor operations, and billing issues, contact support with your account email, course context, and issue timeline.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using LinguistPro, you agree to use the platform lawfully, provide accurate account information, and respect tutor, student, and administrator community standards.
terms.accountResponsibilityBody: Users are responsible for account credentials, activity under their account, and compliance with all published platform policies.
terms.serviceChangesBody: We may update features and policies for security, legal, or product reasons. Material policy changes will be announced to registered users.
